crossRefs.note: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.
Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

people.name: Tertius
people.line: Paul's scribe who wrote the Epistle to the Romans

translations.web: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.
translations.bsb: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
translations.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
translations.asv: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.
